method: Era deep-dives expanded from data/v1/transmission.json against data/artist.json (discography), data/v1/years.json, data/sessions.json, data/v1/circle.json, and data/v1/codex.json. collaborators[] holds EVERY in-era collaborator (transmission.json keeps only the top 3). summary figures are recomputed and asserted in scripts/build_eras.py. Titles and metadata only - never lyrics, never invented bio facts.

eras.name: The First Rite
eras.scene: The first casting — a guest verse in 2017, then the WoT seal pressed onto Master Key.
eras.note: WoT label era; earliest trace is a 2017 feature credit on another artist's single.

milestones.title: Mistakes Ft. JO$E DRIPP (prod. Tec)
milestones.fact: The first transmission to summon another voice. The circle starts here and grows to twenty-one collaborators.

eras.signal: 79 transmissions, 220,688 plays — 85.7% of every play in the archive. Two years carried the whole catalog.
